title: dipterocarpus obtusifolius var. vestitus
intro: Dipterocarpus obtusifolius var. vestitus, commonly known as the Borneo ironwood, is a tree species belonging to the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Dipterocarpus obtusifolius var. vestitus involve wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
